sort.label: Chunk 1 of 6: Sort the rules
sort.todo: Categorize each rule in my-work/1-rule-sort.md as check, reviewer or both. R5 and R7 are done for you.

checks.label: Chunk 2 of 6: Build the checks
checks.todo: Run /plan-checks in Claude. It asks you three questions, then builds your checks in scripts/checks.py and the pre-commit hook.

reviewer.label: Chunk 3 of 6: Build the reviewer agent
reviewer.todo: Run /interview-reviewer in Claude. Then ./lab review try.
reviewer.done: It gives a verdict on every practice PR. Then: ./lab next

scorer.label: Chunk 4 of 6: Build a scorer
scorer.todo: Run /design-eval in Claude. It interviews you and builds your scorer.

improve.label: Chunk 5 of 6: Improve your reviewer
improve.todo: Run ./lab eval twice for a baseline. Change one thing, then ./lab eval --note "what I changed". When you're happy with your reviewer: ./lab holdout.

gate.label: Chunk 6 of 6: Add a human gate and close the loop
gate.todo: Run /design-gate in Claude. Then ./lab pipeline, and ./lab loop pr-03.
gate.done: ./lab test-gate passes and you've run ./lab loop.
